projects.title: First Cities Evidence Dig
projects.question: How can evidence explain the move from mobile communities to early cities?
projects.glance: Reconstruct early settlement and a Mesopotamian city using artifacts, maps and competing explanations.
projects.product: One evidence reconstruction board with a map/timeline, labeled artifacts, causal links and a revised explanation; each student supplies a private source-based argument.
understandings: Historical explanations depend on evidence and its limits.
Agriculture changed work, settlement and exchange unevenly.
Geography, institutions and technology interact in city development.
